module_summary: Stream arbiter wrapping a round-robin or priority arbitration tree that multiplexes NumInp valid/ready input streams onto one output stream.

anchors.name: inp_valid_i
anchors.why: Per-input valid vector, request lines into the arbiter tree.

anchors.name: inp_ready_o
anchors.why: Per-input ready vector, grant outputs of the arbiter tree.

anchors.name: inp_data_i
anchors.why: Input payloads multiplexed by the arbiter tree.

anchors.name: oup_valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid, request from arbiter tree root.

anchors.name: oup_ready_i
anchors.why: Output ready, grant back into the arbiter tree.

anchors.name: oup_data_o
anchors.why: Selected payload from the winning input.

anchors.name: clr_i
anchors.why: Synchronous clear of the arbiter's round-robin/lock state.

groups.name: arbiter_tree
groups.description: Round-robin or priority arbitration tree selecting one input stream.
